Package org.codehaus.mojo.jaxb2.javageneration

Class EpisodeJarSupport

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.codehaus.mojo.jaxb2.javageneration.EpisodeJarSupport
  • public final class EpisodeJarSupport
extends Object
    Locates JAXB episode resources within artifact JARs and materializes them as local files suitable for XJC external binding inputs. The episode discovery order is:
    1. An explicitly configured resource path, if provided.
    2. META-INF/sun-jaxb.episode (the JAXB RI convention).
    3. META-INF/JAXB/sun-jaxb.episode.xjb.
    4. The single .xjb file directly within META-INF/JAXB/ (the location used by this plugin when packaging generated episodes), provided exactly one such file exists.
    Since:
    4.1.1
    See Also:
    EpisodeArtifact

    • Method Detail

      • selectEpisodeEntry

        public static String selectEpisodeEntry​(File artifactFile,
                                        String explicitResourcePath,
                                        String coordinate)
                                 throws org.apache.maven.plugin.MojoExecutionException

        Selects the episode entry within the supplied artifact file, following the discovery order defined by this class. Extracted episode files preserve the timestamp of the source JAR entry, so that incremental builds re-generate only when the episode artifact changes.

        Parameters:
        artifactFile - The resolved artifact file (JAR) to search.
        explicitResourcePath - An explicit resource path within the artifact, or null for auto-discovery.
        coordinate - The Maven coordinate of the artifact, used in diagnostics.
        Returns:
        The name of the selected JAR entry, or null if no episode was found.
        Throws:
        org.apache.maven.plugin.MojoExecutionException - If the artifact is not a readable JAR, an explicitly configured resource path does not exist, or multiple episode candidates exist.

      • extractEpisodeEntry

        public static File extractEpisodeEntry​(File artifactFile,
                                       String entryName,
                                       Path extractionRoot,
                                       String groupId,
                                       String artifactId,
                                       String version)
                                throws org.apache.maven.plugin.MojoExecutionException

        Extracts the supplied entry from the artifact JAR to a deterministic location beneath extractionRoot: groupId/artifactId/version/entryName. Guarded against path traversal (ZIP-slip). The extracted file is stamped with the JAR entry's timestamp (or the artifact file's, if the entry has none), enabling stable incremental builds.

        Parameters:
        artifactFile - The resolved artifact file (JAR).
        entryName - The JAR entry name to extract.
        extractionRoot - The root directory beneath which the entry is materialized.
        groupId - The groupId of the artifact (used for the target path).
        artifactId - The artifactId of the artifact (used for the target path).
        version - The version of the artifact (used for the target path).
        Returns:
        The extracted, existing episode file.
        Throws:
        org.apache.maven.plugin.MojoExecutionException - If the JAR cannot be read or the entry cannot be extracted.
